hero.description: Hill University Center at the University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB), built in 1983 as University Center. Renamed in 1991 to honor former university president S. Richardson Hill. Closed and demolished in fall 2013. The larger Hill Student Center, occupying the same site, was completed in December 2015. [Source: Bhamwiki https://www.bhamwiki.com/w/Hill_University_Center ]
